## Choppy v1.30

📋⚡ Windows 10 / 11 - fast, clear file copier ⚡ everything that matters in one plain, dark window.

### What's in v1.30
- **Many small files with a hard disk at either end, much faster:** small files are read in batches (up to 256 MB) in the order they sit on the disk, then written through the Windows cache, which puts them out in one sweep. 1,000 files (64 KB - 8 MB) between two hard disks: about 91 MB/s, up from about 75; within one hard disk: about 68 MB/s, up from about 59.

### Install / Update
1. Download **Choppy-v1.30.zip** and extract all files (or use the PowerShell one-liner from the README).
2. Double-click **Activate Choppy.cmd** (or run `build.ps1` and choose **[1]**).
3. Remove at any time with **Revert to Windows Copy.cmd**.
